description: All 18 fixed synthetic users in the Dossier hard-v1 benchmark. The 288 films are invented test cases, not actual releases.

howToRead.trainingCandidateRatings: These 216 films are eligible to be shown to Dossier. Each run reveals only a subset, chosen by the experiment.
howToRead.heldOutRatings: These 72 secret ratings are used to score Dossier predictions and are never supplied during training.
howToRead.ratingDossierWouldSee: The rating supplied if the film is selected for training. For noisy_rater, some of these deliberately differ from hiddenRating.
howToRead.hiddenTasteDescription: Evaluator-only description. Dossier does not receive it.
howToRead.filmTitles: Names such as "Animated wonder 2" are category labels plus a variant number. The generator made 24 categories with 12 films each. These are placeholders, not real film titles.
howToRead.catalogueLimit: The controlled catalogue supports repeatable tests, but its repeated categories and invented film details cannot establish performance on real films or real viewers.
